scope: Explicit verified web release source-map upload policy
incident: A dirty local production build instantiated the upload plugin solely because a token was configured. Upload release identity could fall back to npm package version. Native builds could instantiate the web dist uploader.
changes: Publisher web build explicitly sets CA_SENTRY_UPLOAD=1.
Before plugin instantiation, require production web target, configured authentication, full 40-character VITE_APP_VERSION equal to Git HEAD, complete Git history, and a clean working tree.
Ignored generated artifacts do not make a release dirty. Native builds never upload a leftover web dist directory.
The upload release name uses only the verified source SHA; package-version fallback is removed.
Existing organization/project selection, authentication environment, nonblocking upload errors, and source-map deletion remain unchanged.
publisher_contract: Resolve the tip step uses commits/main .sha or full github.sha fallback. Build checkout and VITE_APP_VERSION both use needs.publish-needed.outputs.target_sha.

tests.fixture: Disposable real Git repositories plus actual Vite configuration import; upload plugin mocked so tests perform no external upload.
covers: missing short package-version or mismatched release identity

validation.node_config_baseline: TS2769 maxParallelFileOps exists in unchanged baseline and guard candidate; root assigned a separate follow-up commit to move this Rollup option to its supported location.

limits: Policy establishes identity at Vite configuration evaluation, before upload plugin instantiation; it does not claim an immutable source snapshot against edits during a running build.
No production Sentry upload was attempted for validation.
Publisher's earlier 403 remains unresolved. Local configured upload success does not prove publisher credentials or permissions.
